action_items: Fixes verified. Main agent may proceed to summarize + hand off production curl commands to user.
Suggest running /admin/audit-paid-plans-without-payment with dry_run=true FIRST on production to review counts before dry_run=false bulk downgrade.
critical_code_review_comments: Webhook signature check is now correctly hard-fail on both missing secret (503) and missing/invalid signature (401). Good — matches security intent.
/admin/audit-paid-plans-without-payment mixes read + write logic (downgrade inside audit loop when dry_run=false). Consider splitting into pure-read /audit and separate /downgrade for safer ops.

The `admin_pin='123456'` is hardcoded across many endpoints in razorpay_payments.py. Move to a constant loaded from env (already have ADMIN_OPERATION_PIN in .env=123456 — endpoints should use os.environ.get('ADMIN_OPERATION_PIN')).
razorpay_payments.py is 3284 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Split into: routes/webhook.py, routes/orders.py, routes/admin_audit.py, routes/admin_fix.py.

auto_sync_captured_from_razorpay cancelled-gate fix and dup-key fix in server.py were not directly re-tested here (would require racing Razorpay API); code inspection confirms both fixes applied per problem statement, but adding a unit test with mocked razorpay_client.order.all() output is advisable.

seed_data_creation: Test users TEST-audit-1-uid, TEST-comp-1-uid, TEST-comp-2-uid and 2 razorpay_orders (cancelled + paid) inserted via pymongo, then deleted in fixture teardown. No production data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 10 spec tests + PIN enforcement verified. If regression on this feature: rerun `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_razorpay_webhook_audit_security.py -v`. auto_sync cron fixes (server.py) not covered by this suite — need mocked razorpay.order.all() test if regression appears.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug had 3 root causes, all now verified fixed: (1) webhook endpoint accepted unsigned payloads → any attacker could forge payment.captured; (2) cron auto-sync activated subscriptions from any Razorpay 'captured' payment even when the local order was 'cancelled/failed/dismissed'; (3) audit + fix endpoints queried db.users.find_one({'user_id': uid}) but the users collection keys on 'uid', so lookups silently returned None → audit reported zero suspicious users despite the leak. All three code paths now enforce correct behaviour and the fix is verified end-to-end via direct MongoDB seed → HTTP call → assertion pattern.
